description:
Foldable, hidden battery, and easy to hop on. (Likebike and Laifook brands will be shipped randomly)
Safety Certified Battery
Cityfun has a Safety Certified Battery (UL2849 Standard) with a capacity of 48V15Ah. It provides safety and enough power for your daily commuting.
1500W Peak Motor
Cityfun ebike features a powerful 500W motor (peak 1500W), delivering ample power for smooth and efficient rides in urban commuting.
Front Suspension
The durable front suspension fork(with Lockable) helps reduce the impacts from the road on the frame to a great extent, which maximizes comfort as well.
Smart Display
Color smart display provides riding data. For example: real-time speed, battery level, PAS level, mileage and more. Display backlight brightness is adjustable. Easily track your ride and reach your cycling goals, day or night
Bright headlight and Taillight
Cityfun equipped with bright headlight and taillight, provide you a safer and more enjoyable environment for nightriding,enjoy riding without time constraints.
Foldable Construction
Effectively saves space with a sleek and user-friendly design
